claim: In the evaluated system, perceived usability and trust exhibit a tension: acceptable usability (mean CUQ 67.2/100) coexists with lower trust (mean 48.8%), with reliability rated as the most critical concern (mean 1.8/5).
falsifier: Replicate the evaluation on the same or similar system to verify the mean usability, trust, and reliability concern scores and the observed tension.

conditions: experimental evaluation with reported mean scores
exclusions: limited to the sampled system and reported experimental conditions

title: System design and deployment–perceived usability and trust principle
